playlists.name: Sexy, Steamy and Smooth
playlists.description: I made this steamy playlist, great for when you're getting it on with your lover. It's got that 90's electronica vibe, but it's chill. You could say it's stereotypical porn music and I would agree with you. Some of the songs are a little on the nose - you could maybe describe this mix as somewhat cheesy, but you have to just embrace it. It's camp, I swear.

playlists.name: Lean Into Your Sadness
playlists.description: I'm someone whose mood is very much affected by the music I'm listening. Sometimes when I'm upset, I can listen to happier, uplifting music and it eventually gets me out of the dumps. Sometimes though, all I want to do is lean into my sadness and indulge myself to the max in my feelings. This playlist is for moments like those. And just remember: it's OK to cry - you will feel better afterwards.
